name: nyra
description: A Tauri desktop client for Claude Code
author: Patrick Dias <https://github.com/pdcamargo>

scripts.build: node scripts/prebundle.mjs && TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY="$(cat $HOME/.tauri/nyra-updater.key)" TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD= tauri build
scripts.package: node scripts/prebundle.mjs && TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY="$(cat $HOME/.tauri/nyra-updater.key)" TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD= tauri build
scripts.gh-release: gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --title v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/*.app.tar.gz src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/*.app.tar.gz.sig latest.json
scripts.release: npm test && npm run test:rust && npm version patch && npm run package && git push && git push --tags && npm run release:manifest && npm run gh-release
scripts.release:minor: npm test && npm run test:rust && npm version minor && npm run package && git push && git push --tags && npm run release:manifest && npm run gh-release
scripts.release:major: npm test && npm run test:rust && npm version major && npm run package && git push && git push --tags && npm run release:manifest && npm run gh-release
